purpose: Test whether the two power-qualified candidate attributes contain predictive information beyond the structural persistence baseline before designing any LLM reasoning treatment.

scope.reason: Only PJD currently has a closed, collision-audited historical head-of-list panel at the required coverage. No coefficient may be extrapolated to the other eight party buckets.

features.source: collision/audit-resolved complete TAFRA/elections.ma 2015 communal elected-member universe

model.target: PJD territorial vote-share residual relative to the frozen structural baseline, represented on the logit scale
model.feature_centering: Within each transition, subtract the fit-transition feature means frozen from 2011_TO_2016; validation reuses those fit means without recentering on 2021.
model.reason_no_interaction: With two binary features, an unrestricted interaction can approximate a four-cell lookup table and would reduce the future C1-vs-C2 reasoning question to deterministic memorization.
model.hyperparameter_selection: Leave-one-region-out cross-validation inside 2011_TO_2016 only; choose lowest mean held-out PJD squared error, ties favor stronger regularization.

forecast_transform.other_parties: Scale every non-PJD C0 share proportionally by (1-q_i)/(1-p_i_C0) so each territory remains a valid composition.
forecast_transform.effect_cap: Cap absolute PJD logit shift at the 90th percentile of absolute fit-transition PJD persistence logit residuals, computed on fit data only and frozen before validation application.

baselines.2016: Frozen 2011 territorial persistence baseline used by E_reason development builder.
baselines.2021: Frozen Bstar V0 structural baseline reproduced by e_reason_build_blind_holdout_bundle.py using only 2011 and 2016 outcomes.

metrics.uncertainty: Paired bootstrap by territory, 10000 replicates, seed 260818.

interpretation_rules.positive_retrospective_signal: Validation improvement has the favorable sign on both primary metrics and paired bootstrap P(model better) >= 0.90 for PJD RMSE.
interpretation_rules.weak_signal: Point estimate improves but P(model better) < 0.90, or only one primary metric improves.
interpretation_rules.no_signal: PJD validation RMSE does not improve over C0.
interpretation_rules.important: No outcome of this retrospective test can retroactively restore 2021 as a blind holdout or authorize deployment.

forbidden: Use 2021 outcomes to select alpha, features, signs, transforms, aliases or effect caps
Add feature interaction after inspecting validation performance
Transfer fitted coefficients to non-PJD parties
Invoke an LLM before this deterministic candidate-intelligence baseline is measured
